**Proposed mechanism:** COG4 (HGNC:2732) —DISRUPTS→ Golgi apparatus protein trafficking and processing (GO:0005794); NSF (HGNC:7740) —DISRUPTS→ Golgi apparatus protein trafficking and processing (GO:0005794); Golgi apparatus protein trafficking and processing (GO:0005794) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250); Golgi apparatus protein trafficking and processing (GO:0005794) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability, severe (HP:0010804); Golgi apparatus protein trafficking and processing (GO:0005794) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal facial shape (HP:0001999). Loss-of-function mutations in COG4 (associated with MONDO:0013281) and NSF (associated with developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 96) disrupt the conserved function of Golgi apparatus protein trafficking and processing. This shared disruption leads to overlapping phenotypes including seizures, intellectual disability, and abnormal facial features.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that variants in COG4 and NSF do not affect Golgi protein trafficking or that the observed phenotypes in MONDO:0013281 and developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 96 are caused by entirely distinct molecular pathways unrelated to protein processing. _(variant: rs12345678)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of COG4 and NSF in Golgi protein trafficking offers potential therapeutic targets for both diseases. Interventions aimed at restoring proper protein transport within the Golgi could alleviate downstream pathological consequences.
